## What changes?

Describe the problem and the user-visible behavior. Link an issue or ADR when relevant.

## How was it tested?

List commands, outcomes, and anything not run. Distinguish a fake-editor test from a Figma Desktop run.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, including rejected input at a trust boundary.
- [ ] Contract/schema/TypeScript changes are kept in sync, if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog match the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, private designs, runtime data, build output, or raw assessment reports are included.

For a suspected vulnerability, stop and follow SECURITY.md rather than posting details here.
